RDM Dashboard is brought to you by Nami Sunami and Liz Guzman-Ramirez, TU/e Data
Stewards.

## Data scope

The dashboard reflects **actual DMPs only**. DMP records that were never
submitted (empty status history / drafts), DMPs currently **Retracted**, and
non-DMP task items in the Research Cockpit that never entered the real DMP
workflow (statuses such as *Done* / *Work in progress* / *In Progress*) are
excluded from all counts and rates on this site.
